verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs say its GitHub integration can automate PR comments [semgrep-docs-57], and that rules can automate code review comments [semgrep-docs-21]. Semgrep Secrets posts comments directly on PRs and MRs [semgrep-docs-10], and CI jobs scan on pull or merge request events [semgrep-docs-25]. missing for 10: explicit documentation of GitLab MR comments for Code and Supply Chain findings (not just Secrets), evidence of GitHub status checks or a check-run view, PR-comment setup/configuration detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
